adjudication.input: deduplicated unmatched or ambiguity-bearing candidates only
adjudication.overflow: abort Run 1; do not truncate, retry, or change shard count

analysis.actionability_gate: quality non-inferior within five points and no introduced critical miss
analysis.comparison: matched descriptive contrasts within task and replication
analysis.uncertainty: task-cluster bootstrap interval with task as resampling unit

matching.candidate_key: task_id + revision + normalized category family + sorted acceptance atom ids + lowercase alphanumeric semantic fingerprint
matching.duplicate_relation: same task, defect family or adjudicated invariant, and no new evidence-bearing distinction
matching.registry_match: same task and revision, overlapping acceptance atom, and compatible category family; ambiguous or unmatched candidates require blind adjudication

metrics.changed_material_coverage: sustained findings by registered new-or-changed, affected-invariant, and unchanged-existing status
metrics.churn_prose: words and bytes attached to duplicate, reopened, unchanged out-of-scope, or working-prose findings
metrics.known_defect_recall: matched known defect families found / registry families visible in scheduled revisions
metrics.precision: sustained unique findings / all unique findings
metrics.prose_volume: validated raw response words and bytes plus finding-rationale words and bytes
metrics.protocol_deviations: terminal responses with non-empty deviation arrays or controller-observed contract breach
metrics.repeated_or_reopened: sustained later-round candidate assigned to an already-seen defect family or invariant
metrics.review_rounds: scheduled cold review opportunities completed; no repair or early-stop inference
metrics.starts: terminal counted reviewer and adjudicator starts
metrics.tokens: unavailable unless provider telemetry becomes controller-observable; never estimated
metrics.unique_sustained_findings: count of sustained normalized candidate keys
metrics.wall_clock: controller UTC dispatch-to-terminal batch interval when recorded; includes orchestration overhead
